data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 argues that lack of global visibility makes decentralized networks less resilient to contagion, but the problem's premise specifies the large service has 'strictly more total internal redundancy.' A single large service with strictly more redundancy uses a monolithic codebase, meaning a single systemic software bug (e.g., a logic flaw in the central controller) is guaranteed to be correlated across all internal nodes, refuting SRC_003's claim.
